rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, pretrain_steps=0, n_iter=50, grad_clip=1.0, outer_wall_s=1400, per_scene_s=None, batch_size=2, lr=0.0003, optimizer=adam, unet_c=16, train_n=400, val_n=200, seed=42, rationale=iter-16 SIX-BOX. (1) PRIOR: iter-15 hr=0.0, minimal warm-start pretrain_epochs=1 gave rmse=0.00640 -- warm-start strength (off/1/3/10 -> ~0.0065/0.0064/0.0063/0.0064) is NON-monotone noise around the plateau, not a lever. Iters 1-15 all hr=0. (2) FAILURE MODE: plain-UNet N2I at the over-smoothed FBP-consistent plateau; no edge-preserving structural guard (bilateral sibling range kernel hr~0.21). (3) ONE KNOB: relative to iter-6 best reference (n_iter=50, lr=3e-4, c=16, pretrain=3), batch_size 1 -> 2 (affects ONLY the warm-start pre-pass; the per-image fit is always batch_size=1 internally). (4) HYPOTHESIS: batch_size=2 gives a lower-variance gradient estimate for the amortised warm-start, so the shared init may be a slightly better generic starting point for the per-image fits; if rmse dips, warm-start batch statistics matter. Per the ceiling, expect hr=0 -- the warm-start converges to the same over-smoothed mean regardless of batch size, so the per-image fits inherit the same plateau. (5) BUDGET: bs=2 halves warm-start steps/epoch (faster) + 200*50-step fast fits + figure ~= 11 min << 30-min wall. (6) Loop continues; iter-17 self-dispatched. Reserved levers: pretrain_steps hard cap, warm_start off + n_iter=400, per_scene_s explicit, n_iter=25 aggressive early-stop, lr=5e-4 mid.
